stem: In August 2026, 2 of the 500 businesses on Business Care, Voltmarkt's device-support subscription, cancelled: a logo churn rate of 0.4%. No business downgraded. Yet August's gross MRR churn rate was 6.0%. What is the most likely explanation?

options.text: The 2 businesses that left paid a large share of the MRR
Many businesses upgraded in August, which raises gross MRR churn
New businesses joined in August, which raises gross MRR churn
Logo churn counts businesses at the end of August, so it is too low
